places.name: Liseberg Amusement Park
places.ai_summary: A popular amusement park featuring thrilling rides, beautiful gardens, and seasonal events like Christmas markets.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during special events.

places.place_tip: Buy tickets online to skip the queue.

attribution.title: Lisebergsportal kväll
attribution.author: Albin Olsson
attribution.description: Den första portalen på gångvägen (Stjärnstigen) mellan Korsvägen och Lisebergs södra entré.

places.name: Universeum Science Center
places.ai_summary: An interactive science center featuring aquariums, a rainforest, and hands-on exhibits for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Extended hours during school holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the rainforest section for a unique experience.

places.name: Haga District
places.ai_summary: A charming neighborhood with cobblestone streets, wooden houses, and cozy cafes, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops may have reduced hours on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Try the cinnamon buns at Café Haga Bottega.

attribution.title: Haganygata
attribution.author: Photographer: Erik of Gothenburg, EVL.
attribution.description: Haga Nygata, pedestrian street of city district Haga, Gothenburg, Sweden.

places.name: Gothenburg Archipelago
places.ai_summary: A group of islands offering stunning coastal scenery, hiking trails, and opportunities for swimming and kayaking.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedules may vary; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Visit the island of Vrångö for a peaceful retreat.

places.name: Feskekörka Fish Market
places.ai_summary: A famous fish market housed in a church-like building, offering a wide variety of fresh seafood and local delicacies.
places.cost: Free to enter; pay for purchases

opening_hours.notes: Open on some public holidays; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the seafood tasting opportunities.

attribution.author: Bahnfrend
attribution.description: View of Feskekôrka, Gothenburg, Sweden

places.name: Slottsskogen Park & Zoo
places.ai_summary: A large park and zoo in the city center, featuring a variety of animals, playgrounds, and walking paths.
places.cost: Free entry; fees for some attractions

opening_hours.notes: Zoo opening hours may vary; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Visit the petting zoo with children.

attribution.title: Slottskogen1
attribution.author: BIL
attribution.description: The park Slottsskogen in Gothenburg, Sweden

places.name: Gothenburg Museum of Art
places.ai_summary: An art museum housing an impressive collection of Nordic art, as well as international works from the 14th century to the present.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Wednesdays.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Maritiman Floating Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum featuring a fleet of historic ships and submarines, offering guided tours and maritime exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring the ships.

attribution.title: HMS Nordkaparen (Nor) (1)
attribution.author: Saftgurka
attribution.description: Swedish submarine HMS Nordkaparen (Nor) at the Martitime Museum in Gothenburg.

places.name: Gothenburg Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A large and diverse botanical garden featuring themed gardens, greenhouses, and a rich collection of plants from around the world.
places.cost: Free entry; fees for some events

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for event schedules.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the tropical greenhouse.

places.name: Avenyn Boulevard
places.ai_summary: The main boulevard in Gothenburg, known for its shops, restaurants, and vibrant atmosphere, especially during events and festivals.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops and restaurants stay open later.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the outdoor restaurants.

attribution.title: Kungsportsavenyn
attribution.author: bachmont
attribution.description: Kungsportsavenyn in Gothenburg, Sweden, viewed from Gothenburg Museum of Art, with the Poseidon statue in front

places.name: Skansen Kronan Fortress
places.ai_summary: A historic fortress offering panoramic views of Gothenburg, with well-preserved buildings and informative exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning city views.

attribution.title: Skansen Kronan Gbg
attribution.author: Rolf Broberg (Rolf B)
attribution.description: The fortlet Skansen Kronan on a hill in Goteborg.

places.name: Gothenburg Opera House
places.ai_summary: A modern opera house with a striking design, offering a variety of performances including opera, ballet, and concerts.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance times.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.name: Museum of World Culture
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to global cultural history, featuring interactive exhibits and a diverse range of artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Participate in a guided tour for deeper insights.

attribution.author: Photographer: Hélène Binet, http://www.varldskulturmuseet.se
attribution.description: Entrance to the Museum of World Culture in Göteborg, Sweden

places.name: Trädgårdsföreningen Garden Society
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park with themed gardens, a palm house, and a popular spot for picnics and relaxation.
places.cost: Free entry; fees for some events

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for event schedules.

places.place_tip: Visit the palm house for a tropical experience.

attribution.author: ArildV
attribution.description: Palmhuset (the palm green house) in Trädgårdsföreningen (The Garden Society of Gothenburg), Gothenburg, Sweden.

places.name: Southern Archipelago Ferry
places.ai_summary: A ferry service providing access to the stunning southern archipelago islands, popular for day trips and nature excursions.

opening_hours.notes: Check the ferry schedule for exact times.

places.place_tip: Visit the island of Styrsö for beautiful nature trails.

places.name: Palm House in Trädgårdsföreningen
places.ai_summary: A stunning greenhouse located within the Trädgårdsföreningen, featuring a wide variety of plants and a tropical climate.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and exotic plants.

attribution.title: Palmhuset Göteborgs trädsgårdsförening september 2011
attribution.author: ArildV
attribution.description: Palmhuset (the palm green house) in Trädgårdsföreningen (The Garden Society of Gothenburg), Gothenburg, Sweden.

places.name: Lilla Bommen Harbor (The Lipstick Tower)
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural landmark and harbor area, known for its distinctive Lipstick Tower and vibrant waterfront.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour from the harbor for a different perspective.

attribution.title: Lilla Bommen in Gothenburg
attribution.author: Mikael Miettinen from Göteborg, Sweden
attribution.description: The marina Lilla Bommen in Gotheburg, Sweden.

places.name: Gothenburg City Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history and culture of Gothenburg, with exhibits ranging from the city's founding to the present day.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Fridays.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for local handicrafts.

attribution.title: Ostindiska huset september 2010b
attribution.author: Ankara
attribution.description: The City Museum of Gothenburg. Located in an eighteenth century house (know as Ostindiska huset, East India building) originally built for the Swedish East India Company.

places.name: Gunnebo House & Gardens
places.ai_summary: A historic mansion with beautiful gardens, offering guided tours and a glimpse into 18th-century life.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available; check schedule.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy a fika at the café.

attribution.title: Gunnebo slott huvudfasaden mot trädgården
attribution.author: Mkallgren
attribution.description: Gunnebo slott, huvudfasaden mot södra stilträdgården med fritrappan.

places.name: Volvo Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history of Volvo, showcasing cars, trucks, and other vehicles, as well as company memorabilia.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the interactive exhibits.
